verdict.rationale: Bento is a hosted observability and trace-storage service, so letting users choose a storage region is a fair axis to judge it on. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or self-hosted storage. The docs cover trace capture, signals, alerts, the CLI, and migrations, but none of these address where the data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
